description: A round-based tactical first-person shooter in the style Counter-Strike made famous, built on three.js 0.187.0 from static files with no build step and no network request. Two teams fight short rounds in the Refinery Yard: Vanguard attacks and plants the charge at Site A (Refinery) or Site B (Silo); Jackals defend. First to 5 rounds takes the match.
name: threejs-fps-01
